common_evaluation: Identical seven IS folds, 8h label, PIT universe, actual funding/fills, base and 2x costs; each variant counts inside the 96-configuration ceiling.

ablations.test: persistence should improve median fold net return
wick geometry must add OOF net Sharpe beyond candle direction
alpha must not reduce to momentum, beta, volatility, liquidity, or funding
expected to fail turnover and 2x-cost gates
stress scaling should reduce drawdown without reversing median return

mechanism_falsifier: Reject if baseline fails any QE gate or fails to beat A3 on median fold net return and A5 on 2x-cost Sharpe.
